business_summary: Dong Suh Companies Inc. engages in the food, packaging, tea, logistics, and import and export businesses. The company produces, imports, and sells food, such as palm oils, cheese, processed fruit and vegetable products, and processed grain products; packaging materials, such as flexible packaging films for food; and tea products, such as coffee, brown rice green tea, and roundworm tea, as well as desserts. Dong Suh Companies Inc. was founded in 1975 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 동서기업주식회사는 식품, 포장, 차, 물류, 수출입 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 회사는 팜유, 치즈, 과일 및 채소 가공품, 곡물 가공품 등 식품을 생산, 수입 및 판매합니다. 식품용 연포장 필름 등의 포장재; 커피, 현미녹차, 회충차 등의 차제품과 디저트 등을 판매하고 있습니다. Dong Suh Companies Inc.는 1975년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 서울에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
